revision_reason: The v2 central comparison is isolated, but the velocity transition still reaches boundary cells numerically and violates the unchanged no-boundary-flux criterion. Extend both the central constant-velocity interval and the initially resting wall buffers. Preserve every dx, timestep, final time, pulse/compared-interval width and acceptance limit; assert both dependency-cone separations before execution.
isolation_policy: Distance in cells from the compared interval to every nonuniform-velocity cell exceeds 4*n_RK*steps plus one cell. Distance of nonzero initial velocity to either physical boundary also exceeds that cone. Four conservatively bounds local flat-bed HP/reconstruction/flux dependencies for fully wet explicit fixtures with a prescribed timestep. Budgets/positivity/TVD cover the entire closed, initially quiescent-boundary domain.
criteria_policy: Original contract.json supplies unchanged roundoff, thermal, fraction, budget and full-field limits; no production or CFL change for transport.
